proposed_widenings.name: on_attached_creature_spends_action
proposed_widenings.justification: The escape mechanic — 'A creature Restrained by the webs can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC' — requires a trigger that fires when the attached (restrained) creature spends an Action. The existing on_caster_spends_action trigger only models the caster spending an action, not the target. This is a new variant of OngoingTrigger.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature Restrained by the webs can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC. If it succeeds, it is no longer Restrained.

proposed_widenings.name: once_per_creature_per_turn predicate on OngoingTrigger
proposed_widenings.justification: The save fires only 'the first time a creature enters the webs on a turn or starts its turn there' — a deduplication guard preventing double-trigger if both on_creature_enters_area and on_attached_turn_start fire in the same turn. No existing OngoingPredicate variant covers this.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The first time a creature enters the webs on a turn or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw.

proposed_widenings.name: area_lightly_obscured
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell makes the area Lightly Obscured (Lightly Obscured = disadvantage on Perception checks to see into/through), which has no EffectAtom. This is distinct from Heavily Obscured and from darkvision — it is an area property, not a creature sense. It has mechanical consequences (Perception disadvantage) that are not captured by any existing atom.
proposed_widenings.evidence: the area within them is Lightly Obscured

notes: Core mechanics encode cleanly: 20-ft cube area attachment, area_is_difficult_terrain (passive), and two Dex-save-gate operations (on_creature_enters_area + on_attached_turn_start → apply_condition restrained). Typecheck and tracer both pass. Three mechanics are omitted: (1) escape mechanic needs a new on_attached_creature_spends_action trigger variant; (2) Lightly Obscured has no atom; (3) fire damage and web collapse are DM/environment-triggered and are dm_agenda. The 'first time per turn' dedup guard is approximated by two separate triggers, which over-triggers in the edge case where a creature exits and re-enters the area in the same turn.
